answer: Random beacon heartbeat checks block fake identities. Each identity must answer a beacon challenge in 10 minutes; 5% are sampled per epoch, two misses slash a 20-unit bond. A terrace of tiers caps newcomers until three passes, so a ripple of fakes cannot claim rewards at once. Faking 1,000 risks 20,000 units and 1,000 slots, versus 20 for one honest agent. Over a 30-epoch horizon, honest agents keep undiluted rewards, so mass faking loses.
